turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I keep forgetting due dates and paying late fees. Any tricks?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Set up autopay for the minimum on every bill, so you're never late. You can still pay extra by hand.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Autopay makes me nervous though. What if there's not enough in the account?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then line up the due dates with your payday. Most companies let you change your billing date if you ask.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, I didn't know that was possible.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It usually is, just call or check the settings online. Having everything due right after payday makes life easier.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll try that with the phone bill first

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good plan. Once it works, move the others over one by one.
